snippet.title: Why Anthropic’s Record IPO Could Be the Peak of the AI Bubble
snippet.description:
On November 19, 2026, Anthropic began trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. This documentary reads the final prospectus (Form 424B4) against the first day of trading: a $900.9 billion bill for computing power that runs until 2045, one share that carries 50.1 percent of the votes, and a $26 billion private placement placed with seven of Anthropic's own suppliers and partners. Then the bulls and the bears make their case.

Heard in the film: Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei at the Nasdaq, Paul Meeks on CNBC and Ed Zitron on CNN (all November 19), Steve Eisman on CNBC (October 29), and Dario Amodei on the Dwarkesh Podcast (February).

🌻 DANDY’S WORLD 1.0 UPDATE IS FINALLY COMING! 😭

Bro, Dandy’s World is finally getting its 1.0 update and there's actually SO MUCH coming! After being in Alpha for so long, the game is finally getting a huge update with new floors, a new game mode, new cards, a coordinator, more lore, and a bunch of other stuff.

In this video, I'm going through everything coming in the new Dandy’s World 1.0 update and showing you all the new things we know about so far. There's honestly a lot to talk about ngl. 😭

🌻 DANDY’S WORLD 1.0 UPDATE

After all this time, Dandy’s World is finally leaving Alpha! This update is bringing some pretty big changes to the game, and things are about to get interesting.

🏢 10+ NEW FLOORS

We're getting more than 10 new floors to explore! There are new areas coming to Gardenview Center, and I'm really curious to see what we'll find on the deeper floors.

🎮 NEW GAME MODE

A brand-new game mode is also coming! It's supposed to be harder than the normal gameplay, so I'm wondering how difficult this is actually going to be.

🃏 NEW CARD SYSTEM

There's a new card system coming to Dandy’s World too! We still don't know everything about how it works, but it's definitely something I'm looking forward to trying out.

🤖 NEW COORDINATOR

A new coordinator character is also being added. This character can adapt its decisions depending on how players play each run, which sounds pretty interesting.

📖 10,000+ WORDS OF NEW LORE

We're also getting over 10,000 words of new lore and dialogue! Hopefully we finally get more answers about Gardenview Center and the Malfunction Incident because there's still so much we don't know.

🎵 NEW ANIMATED MUSIC VIDEO

There's also a new animated music video coming with the full theme song for the Dandy’s World animated series, along with a brand-new character reveal!

🔥 MORE STUFF COMING:

📖 New lore and dialogue

I'm also checking out all the new information, looking for leaks, secrets, and anything else we might have missed about the 1.0 update.

There's a lot coming to Dandy’s World, and I can't wait to see how everything looks when the update drops. Make sure you watch till the end because there's a lot to talk about!

snippet.description:
Washington, Oregon, California: 50-Ft Waves, King Tides and a Thanksgiving Storm Train

Last weekend, the National Weather Service warned of breaking waves of 25 to 35 feet on the California coast, with occasional sets of 40 to 50 feet at favored breakpoints like Mavericks. Now the threat shifts from waves to water levels. Today, Wednesday, Nov. 18, an atmospheric river is soaking California: a Coastal Flood Advisory covers San Francisco Bay, wind gusts reach 70 mph in the East Bay Hills, 2 to 4 feet of snow is forecast for the Sierra, and Flood Watches cover Southern California on Thursday. In Washington, Ocean Shores remains under a state of emergency after storms tore away hundreds of feet of its protective berm. King tides arrive Nov. 23–27 in Washington and Oregon and Nov. 24–26 in California, right through Thanksgiving, and forecasters are watching a more active storm pattern, including the potential for a major atmospheric river during Thanksgiving week. We go state by state, explain what king tides are, look at the storm train and El Niño, and cover how to stay safe.

We follow nature's fury with facts, not fear — so you understand what's coming and stay one step ahead.
